full_judgment: 5. Defendant Nos. 11 and 12 contested the suit by filing joint written statement. Their contention is that Dhanobar and Nafar sold the suit land out and out to the defendants Nos. 4 and 5 by Kabala dated 26-2-52 (Exhibit 2) and the said deed was not a mortgage deed. It was an out and out sale deed and the allegation of returning the suit land by the defendant Nos. 4 and 5 is false and fabricated and the suit land has been accordingly recorded in the SA Khatian in the names of the defendants 4 and 5 correctly. Defendant No. 4 is Panchanan Pal and the defendant No. 5 is Santosh Kumar having migrated to India, the land was enlisted as enemy property. Defendant No. 11 is in possession of the suit land as lessee from the Government.
